nodes.title: Epic: process-vs-inventory analysis and topology comparison plots
nodes.description: Make the analysis stack answer buy-devices vs cut-process-time using shared cabinet, topologies 1-1-1/2-3-2/5-3-5, wait reports, shift pulse, compare plots, and recommend. OpenSpec: openspec/specs/process-vs-inventory/spec.md
nodes.acceptance_criteria: One command emits analytic+sim metrics per topology; plot artifacts for wait/utilization/cycle time; recommend table chooses buy vs cut T_O vs 2nd slot; docs state baseline.yaml is not the site cabinet.
